correlation_heatmap.png.insight: Ride duration correlates strongly with vehicle turnaround time (V_TAT, r≈0.91) and moderately with customer turnaround time (C_TAT, r≈0.41). Booking value and ride distance show almost no correlation — check fare logic or data quality.

avg_distance_by_vehicle.png.insight: Average ride distances are ~14–16 km for cars and bikes; Autos show much shorter trips (~7 km). Use this to tune vehicle allocation and pricing for last-mile vs longer trips.

cancellations_by_vehicle.png.insight: Driver-side cancellations are the largest share across vehicle types, especially for premium categories. Consider driver incentives or stricter SLAs for premium vehicles.

cancellations_by_payment.png.insight: Cancellation rates are similar across payment methods. Cash and UPI account for the largest volumes, so small differences there affect totals most.

cancellations_by_hour.png.insight: Driver cancellations are consistently higher than customer cancellations across hours, with mild peaks during typical commute windows (≈7–10 and 17–20).

customer_segmentation.png.insight: Top 5% by value and top 5% by frequency have similar ride distances (~14 km) and ratings (~4.0). Treat value and frequency segments with tailored retention strategies.

weekly_ride_volume.png.insight: Weekly ride volume is stable around a baseline with an end-of-period drop driven by partial data; flag incomplete weeks when reporting.

rides_by_day.png.insight: Weekdays (Mon–Wed) show higher volumes; weekends are lower. Opportunity: weekend-targeted promotions to smooth demand.

ride_distance_boxplot.png.insight: Most rides fall between 0–26 km (IQR=26). Few long rides near 50 km exist but are within expected variability.

booking_value_boxplot.png.insight: Booking values cluster between ₹200–₹600 with a long right tail; values > ~₹1,190 are flagged as potential high-value outliers (validate for surge/pricing errors).

incomplete_reasons.png.insight: Top incomplete/failed ride reasons include 'Customer Demand' and 'Vehicle Breakdown'. Focus on fleet maintenance and flexible customer options to reduce incompletes.

top_customers_value.png.insight: Top customers contribute materially to revenue (top ~10 customers ~₹5k–8k). Consider loyalty perks to retain these high-value users.
